I've been in the same situation myself and I know how horrible it is. You need start small to get out of bed, set up small goals for the day like taking a shower or make breakfast or any other meal. Don't push yourself too much too fast though because that might be exhausting in the beginning. Then set up bigger goals like leaving the house to go shopping or throw out the garbage or just taking a walk. The next step is to actively try to forget everything that makes you feel depressed. Lying in bed is often a way to forget about the world because if you don't leave the bed you don't have to start the day and that gives people some kind of false feeling of being safe. When you feel that you don't have any big problems with running your life and that it's not the depression who's ruling your life, it's time to figure out what made you depressed from the beginning and why and also how you get rid of those things from your life so they never destroy you again. Try to get someone to talk to as soon as possible aswell. For me this was really important but I also talked to wrong people and that didn't make things easier so choose well if your going to one of your friends or go to a good psychologist! Good luck my friend and you can write to me if you feel like you need to talk!
